name: an explicit diff on a reference overrides the rename's auto-rewrite
description: The bot can rename a file and, in the same batch, emit a unified_diff that rewrites a referencing line to something other than the auto-target. Because the post-apply pass only sees the batch's end state, no [[old]] survives to be auto-rewritten, so the explicit edit wins.

after..jade/operations-log/v1.jsonl:
{"ts": "<TS>", "commit_message": "Rename with explicit override", "operations": [{"op": "rename_path", "from": "old.md", "to": "new.md"}, {"op": "unified_diff", "path": "ref.md", "diff": "@@ -1 +1 @@
-see [[old.md]] for details
+see [[something_else.md]] for details
"}]}
